title: Plausible Business to self-hosted Matomo
summary: Matomo does far more than Plausible and costs far more to run. Whether that is a trade or a downgrade depends entirely on what you actually look at.

you_lose: Plausible's speed and its one-screen simplicity, which is why people choose it
A managed service that never needs a cron job debugged
Funnels and revenue tracking on the cloud plan
you_gain: Fifteen years of features: heatmaps, session recording, goals, e-commerce, A/B tests
GDPR tooling that a European auditor already recognises
GPL-3.0, and an importer that can pull your history out of Google Analytics

caveats: Matomo's archiving cron is the piece that bites people. If it is not running, your reports quietly stop updating and nothing tells you.
Disk grows fast on a busy site. The 40 GB here suits modest traffic; budget more if you have real volume.
If you picked Plausible because it is simple, Matomo is not an upgrade. Read the Umami page instead — it is the closer swap.
